title: rule.published
description: A reviewed rule version became published and is in force from effective_from. Producer: rulebook (on review approval). Consumers: applicability-engine, notification, qa.

rule_id.description: The rule the version belongs to.

summary.description: Short plain-language summary; empty when none was written.

effective_from.description: First day the version is in force.

effective_to.description: Day the version stops being in force (exclusive); null when open.

supersedes.description: Rule version ids this version supersedes.

approved_by.description: Users who approved the publication; two for high-impact rules.

high_impact.description: True when the rule carries a high-impact tag.

attribute_keys.description: Ontology attribute keys the predicates reference; the engine's coarse filter.
